name: Jungle Microservice Maze
story: The team is lost in a dense service maze. Orders reach the API gateway, but the Order Service fails when it checks stock.

evidence.title: Service Dependency Map
evidence.content: Browser -> API Gateway -> Order Service -> Inventory Service

evidence.title: Order API Response
evidence.content: POST /api/orders returns HTTP 500: Unable to complete order

evidence.title: Order Service Logs
evidence.content:
INFO Received order request for productId=45
INFO Calling Inventory Service: http://inventory-service/inventory/check
ERROR Inventory check failed: 404 Not Found

actions.text: Increase memory limit for Order Service
Update the Inventory Service path to /api/inventory/check

hints: Both services are running. Look at the API response from the dependency call.
The Order Service receives a 404 from Inventory Service.
Compare the path in the logs with the Inventory API documentation.
rootCause: Order Service called /inventory/check, but Inventory Service exposes /api/inventory/check.
learningPoint: Healthy microservices can still fail when API contracts or configured endpoint paths do not match.
